our_interpretation: 'Very few' means a small proportion of users, not a small absolute subscriber count.
The OpenAI-focused context suggests other OpenAI products, although the wording could extend to competing AI services.
'User numbers weren’t there' means a lack of substantial adoption, not literally zero users. The speaker supplies no comparison threshold.
I use the latest prepublication calendar quarter, April through June 2025, for this ongoing adoption claim. Earlier snapshots are contextual unless the source reports them as current in that quarter.
Subscribers, weekly active users, developers and daily users are different measures. A subscriber-to-weekly-user ratio is approximate.

criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable figures show a substantial paying share, or reliable adoption measures establish substantial use outside ChatGPT under the stated product scope.
